description: A publicly available dataset produced by the University of Oxford that records daily government COVID-19 policy responses, including stringency and school-closure measures, across countries.
title: Oxford COVID-19 Government Response Tracker (OxCGRT)

description: A 15-item multiple-choice diagnostic test developed by Jena (2015) to assess undergraduate students’ understanding of mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation and identify related misconceptions.
title: Oxidative Phosphorylation Concept Test (OPCT)
